title: Titanium Femoral Condyle
alloyReason: Ti-6Al-7Nb (ASTM F1295) is selected as a nickel-free alternative for Titanium Femoral Condyle, replacing vanadium with niobium to eliminate potential cytotoxic effects while maintaining 900 MPa tensile strength equivalent to Ti-6Al-4V. The Nb-stabilized beta phase provides comparable work-hardening behavior without the toxicity concerns associated with vanadium oxides — critical for Total knee femoral condyle component (Ti-6Al-7Nb) in permanent implant applications. This rationale is driven by total knee femoral condyle component (ti-6al-7nb) and service environment demands.

commonFailures: Fe contamination from machining - requires acid passivation 20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C per ASTM F86 — critical for total knee femoral performance

faq.q: Is Titanium Femoral Condyle MRI-safe or MRI-conditional?
faq.a: Ti-6Al-7Nb is non-ferromagnetic (magnetic susceptibility 1.00005 × 10⁻⁶ cgs) and generates negligible MRI artifact compared to 316L stainless steel. Titanium Femoral Condyle is classified as MR-Conditional under ASTM F2052/F2213 testing at 1.5T and 3.0T field strengths. Specific absorption rates remain within safe limits for total knee femoral configurations.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Femoral Condyle orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Femoral Condyle is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Femoral Condyle?
faq.a: Each Titanium Femoral Condyle shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for total knee femoral.
